children: The Board of Directors of Karnataka Bank, at its meeting held on November 15, has appointed Biji Sreekrishnavilas Sankaranarayanan, Executive Director, to hold charge as Managing Director and Chief Executive Officer (MD and CEO) of the bank on an interim basis for a period of two months with effect from November 16, 2026, or up to the date on which the full time / regular MD and CEO assumes charge, whichever is earlier.
The bank informed the stock exchanges that the Reserve Bank of India conveyed its approval for the aforesaid appointment vide its letter dated November 11, 2026.

The bank also informed the stock exchanges that Raghavendra Srinivas Bhat ceased to be the MD and CEO of the bank with effect from the close of business hours on November 15, 2026, upon completion of his tenure.

Biji SS, who has been working as ED of the bank since July 15, 2026, has 31 years of end-to-end experience across corporate banking, retail and branch banking, liabilities, secured assets, transformation, and digital modernisation.

The bank informed the stock exchanges that Biji SS focused on accelerating enterprise-wide profitability, strengthening compliance architecture, building high-performance leadership pipelines and shaping the next phase of organisational growth through strategic vision, execution discipline and transformation-oriented banking leadership during her banking career.

title: Karnataka Bank appoints Biji SS as interim MD and CEO
